## LEDGER

**(a) Obligations**

**OB-1 — VIOLATOR: long-lived manager owns in-flight fading trails, never records which page, never torn down on page change.** — **CLOSED**
closers:
- `tldraw packages/editor/src/lib/editor/managers/ScribbleManager/ScribbleManager.ts` — read verbatim. `interface Session {id, items, state, options, idleTimeoutHandle, fadeElapsed, totalPointsAtFadeStart}` (48–56) carries **no page identity**; `private sessions = new Map<string, Session>()` (60) lives on an editor-lifetime manager (`constructor(private editor: Editor)`, 62). `startSession` (74–99) records no page. Nothing resets on page change.
- `tldraw .../ClickManager/ClickManager.ts` — read verbatim. `_clickState`, `_clickTimeout`, `_clickScreenPoint`, `_previousScreenPoint`, `_isPressingWhilePending` (15–23, 61): an interaction still in progress on an editor-lifetime object. `cancelDoubleClickTimeout()` (167–174) exists but is never wired to a page change.
- `tldraw .../EdgeScrollManager/EdgeScrollManager.ts` — read verbatim. `_isEdgeScrolling`, `_edgeScrollDuration` (13–14), reset only by proximity, never by scope change.
- `tldraw .../SnapManager/SnapManager.ts` — read verbatim. `_snapIndicators = atom<SnapIndicator[]|undefined>` (39) with `clearIndicators()` (50–54); `getCurrentPageId()` appears only inside the `getSnappableShapes` computed (100) — the indicator atom itself is not page-scoped and is never cleared on page change.

**OB-2 — transient status of an in-flight fetch reset when its scope changes.** — **CLOSED**
closers:
- `query packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts` — read verbatim. `#updateQuery()` (703–719) swaps `#currentQuery`, resets `#currentQueryInitialState = query.state`, and moves the observer off `prevQuery` onto the new one; `setOptions` (138–219) re-derives result, stale timeout and refetch interval whenever `this.#currentQuery !== prevQuery`. This is the contract done right on a long-lived owner.
- `db packages/db/src/query/subset-dedupe.ts` — `reset()` bumps a generation so in-flight requests resolving afterwards skip `updateTracking`.

**OB-3 — a pending selection reset when the scope changes underneath it.** — **CLOSED**
closers: `table packages/table-core/src/features/RowSelection.ts` (`resetRowSelection`, `autoResetRowSelection`), `table .../features/RowPagination.ts` (`autoResetPageIndex` — "pagination will be reset to the first page when page-altering state changes e.g. `data` is updated"), `table .../features/RowExpanding.ts` (`autoResetExpanded`).

**OB-4 — an interaction still in progress reset when scope changes.** — **CLOSED**
closers: `tldraw .../ClickManager/ClickManager.ts`, `tldraw .../EdgeScrollManager/EdgeScrollManager.ts`, `tldraw .../SnapManager/SnapManager.ts` (as above), and `xyflow packages/react/src/store/index.ts` + `packages/svelte/src/lib/store/index.ts` — the two sibling adapters that each own in-progress connection state and do not import one another, over the shared core `packages/system/src/types/general.ts`.

**Contract owner and in-repo counterexamples (EVIDENCE — all named in `files` per 6.3):**
- `tldraw .../managers/EditorManager.ts` — **OWNER**. Read verbatim: the base class defining the folder's one teardown contract ("whatever sets a thing up is what tears it down… it can't be forgotten"). A scope-change reset hook belongs here. Notably `ScribbleManager`, `ClickManager`, `EdgeScrollManager` and `SnapManager` do **not** extend it.
- `tldraw .../SpatialIndexManager/SpatialIndexManager.ts` (10 `PageId` references) and `.../CollaboratorsManager/CollaboratorsManager.ts` (4) — the in-folder siblings that **do** record the page their state belongs to. A `the_receipts` bulk_search over all 18 managers is the proof: only these two and `SnapManager` (1, and only in a computed) mention `PageId` at all; `ScribbleManager`, `ClickManager`, `EdgeScrollManager`, `FontManager`, `InputsManager`, `PerformanceManager`, `HistoryManager`, `TextManager` mention it **nowhere**.

**(b) SWEEP MATRIX**

| OB | repos[] | SWEPT | 3.5 |
|---|---|---|---|
| OB-1 | tldraw, xyflow, primitives, react, redux-devtools, table | all 6 | ✅ holds |
| OB-2 | query, db, router, redux-toolkit, jotai | all 5 | ✅ holds |
| OB-3 | table, xyflow, tldraw, primitives, db, router | **table only** | ❌ **fails — 5 pairs unswept** |
| OB-4 | xyflow, tldraw, primitives, react, redux-devtools, table | xyflow, tldraw, primitives, react, redux-devtools | ❌ **fails — table unswept for this phrase** |

Stating this plainly rather than hiding it: OB-3 and OB-4 did not complete their repo lists — `stakeout` hit its allowance repeatedly and the remaining pairs were traded for folds and verbatim reads. Those repos are covered only obliquely (via dragnet's behaviour lens and the OB-1 sweeps), so their files rank in band 2, not band 1.

**FOLDED vs CONFIRMED:** folds ran from `ScribbleManager.ts`, `EditorManager.ts` and `RowSelection.ts`. The ASSERT `FOLDED == CONFIRMED` does **not** fully hold — `ClickManager`, `EdgeScrollManager`, `SnapManager`, `SpatialIndexManager`, `CollaboratorsManager` and `queryObserver.ts` were confirmed but not individually folded.
